name: flow-agent-automation-v2
description: Make Flow v2 use Google Flow Agent as the default prompt author and generation operator. The app assistant only operates tools, ERP image selection, Flow execution, dashboard review, and ERP archive. The primary path no longer depends on Google Sheet prompts, generates 4 images by default, auto-approves Flow Agent generation prompts, and keeps dashboard review as the final human review gate.

userStories.title: Default 4-image Flow Agent generation
userStories.description: As an operator, I want every Flow Agent generation to create 4 images by default while still allowing edits, so that each product gets a usable batch without extra setup.
acceptanceCriteria: The Flow module defaults image count to 4 for Agent-based runs.
The user can edit the count before running.
Existing non-Agent create flows are not broken.
The backend payload carries the chosen count into the Flow Agent execution path.
Quality gates in metadata.qualityGates pass.

userStories.title: Sheetless primary automation path
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the main automation path to work without Google Sheet prompts, so that ERP plus Flow Agent is enough to create product images.
acceptanceCriteria: The default Auto ERP run does not fail because no Google Sheet prompt matches.
Google Sheet prompt library remains optional or secondary, not required for the primary path.
UI copy makes clear that Flow Agent writes the prompt for the main path.
Existing Sheet status does not block ERP image selection and Flow Agent execution.
Quality gates in metadata.qualityGates pass.

userStories.title: In-app AI as tool operator only
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the app AI to operate the workflow rather than write final prompts, so that prompt quality comes from Flow Agent and the local assistant stays predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: The assistant panel no longer presents its own final image prompt as the production prompt.
Assistant actions can search ERP, choose a card/attachment, set module values, and start the automation.
Assistant output explains what it will send to Flow Agent without pretending to generate the final prompt locally.
Action buttons run immediately after selection when the user chooses a valid card/image.
Quality gates in metadata.qualityGates pass.

userStories.title: Flow Agent interaction and auto approval
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the app to talk to Google Flow Agent, attach the selected ERP reference, and approve Flow Agent's confirmation automatically, so that long generation runs do not stall.
acceptanceCriteria: The runner opens the configured Flow project and enables Agent mode when available.
The runner sends product analysis instructions, selected ERP image context, and requested image count to Flow Agent.
If Flow asks for generation approval, the app chooses approve-and-do-not-ask-again when available, then approves.
The runner detects results from streamChat, batchGenerateImages, or project image scanning.
Timeouts produce a clear recoverable error instead of looping forever.
Quality gates in metadata.qualityGates pass.

userStories.title: Dashboard review and same-card ERP archive
userStories.description: As an operator, I want generated images reviewed on the dashboard before archiving, so that only approved outputs return to the original ERP card.
acceptanceCriteria: Flow Agent approval is automatic, but final image approval on the dashboard remains human-gated.
Approved dashboard images are recorded back to the same source ERP card.
Rejected or pending images are not archived to ERP.
The history view shows source card, selected attachment, Flow artifacts, dashboard status, and archive result.
Quality gates in metadata.qualityGates pass.

userStories.title: Hidden long-run verification
userStories.description: As an operator, I want ralph-tui and browser verification to run in the background, so that the app can be tested thoroughly without taking over my screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Ralph/Codex verification can run with the browser headless or backgrounded.
Long tests may run as needed until the feature is stable.
The final report includes commands run, browser verification result, and remaining risks.
No secrets, tokens, or private keys are pushed to GitHub.
Quality gates in metadata.qualityGates pass.

qualityGates: real or safe smoke run proving selected ERP image context reaches Flow Agent and returns artifacts or a clear recoverable error

decisions.primaryFlow: ERP source image -> Google Flow Agent writes prompt -> generate images -> dashboard review -> archive approved images to the same ERP card
decisions.promptSource: Google Flow Agent only for the production prompt
